name: blog-18
description: Three-column story grid with client-side numbered pagination and newer and older controls.

files.content:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, } from "@designali/icons" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const posts = [ { title: "A design school for people who hate tutorials", cat: "Design", date: "Nov 14", image: "/img/ask/ask1.jpg" }, { title: "Twelve hours inside a Figma file", cat: "Code", date: "Nov 12", image: "/img/ask/ask2.jpg" }, { title: "Inside the Dalim Fonts archive", cat: "Craft", date: "Nov 9", image: "/images/templates/dalim-fonts-old.jpg" }, { title: "Running a template store with four products", cat: "Business", date: "Nov 7", image: "/images/templates/resort.jpg" }, { title: "The designers who ship at 2am", cat: "Design", date: "Nov 4", image: "/img/ask/ask5.jpg" }, { title: "Redrawing icons as a weekly ritual", cat: "Craft", date: "Nov 1", image: "/images/templates/dalim-icons-old.jpg" }, { title: "A walking guide to the Designali work page", cat: "Code", date: "Oct 29", image: "/images/templates/dalim-works-old.jpg" }, { title: "What a template sells in its first week", cat: "Business", date: "Oct 26", image: "/images/templates/portfolio-simple.jpg" }, { title: "Motion design for the impatient", cat: "Design", date: "Oct 22", image: "/img/ask/ask7.jpg" }, { title: "Sketchbooks of a design engineer", cat: "Craft", date: "Oct 19", image: "/img/ask/ask9.jpg" }, { title: "Weekend projects you can build with blocks", cat: "Code", date: "Oct 15", image: "/images/templates/vercel.jpg" }, { title: "The economics of a one-person studio", cat: "Business", date: "Oct 12", image: "/stock/strategy.jpg" }, ] const perPage = 6 export default function Blog18() { const [page, setPage] = useState(1) const pages = Math.ceil(posts.length / perPage) const visible = posts.slice((page - 1) * perPage, page * perPage) return (

Designali magazine

Showing {(page - 1) * perPage + 1}–{Math.min(page * perPage, posts.length)} of {posts.length} stories

{visible.map((p) => (
{p.cat} · {p.date}

{p.title}

))}
{Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => ( ))}
) }
